name: Ihara Nariyuki
source:
He lives alone, away from his parents. As an only child, he is easily swayed and irresponsible. He have many ideas but lacks courage and initiative.

If he don't let his cousin, Honori, stay at his place, his parents will stop sending him money. He work part-time as a tutor to supplement my living expenses.
